surfaceAlpha.$description: Opacity of surface background inside GlassBox containers.

grainAlpha.$description: Opacity of grain/noise texture overlay on GlassBox.

alpha.$description: Opacity of the radial accent gradient emanating from top-left of the screen.

radius.$description: Radius of the accent radial glow in dp/px.

borderLight.$description: Alpha of white border highlight on raised surfaces — creates depth via edge contrast against #000.

insetHighlight.$description: Alpha of inset top edge light on raised cards.

insetShadow.$description: Alpha of inset bottom shadow on raised cards — dark recess against surface.

steelGlow.$description: Alpha of steel accent drop shadow for elevation without black-on-black invisibility.

steelGlowRadius.$description: Blur radius in dp/px of the steel accent elevation glow.

start.$description: Lightest stop of the diagonal gradient — barely off-black, defines direction.

mid.$description: Mid stop of the diagonal gradient.

end.$description: End stop — pure black, blends with base background.

angle.$description: Angle in degrees for the diagonal elevation gradient.

borderAlpha.$description: Alpha of border on gradient surfaces — uses steel accent (#A8B0BC) as base color.

innerHighlight.$description: Alpha of inset top edge highlight on gradient surfaces.
